_comment: Local dev overrides — copy to dev-overrides.json (GITIGNORED, NEVER commit) and fill in. cloud-core's _loadDevOverrides force-assigns these onto the config singleton in dev, so utils.DEVELOPER_* resolves with no schema change. The microservice is the CLI's REST api-client running in the cloud, authenticated AS THE DEVELOPER (the app owner) via their durable wallet credential. Copy walletAddress + signature from the repo's .descix/wallet.json. createServiceApiClient hard-fails (no fallback) if either is absent.
